claims.text: NeuronBlocks includes various neural network modules categorized in the Block Zoo, such as embedding layers, CNNs, RNNs, and Transformers.
The toolkit supports multiple NLP tasks including text classification, sequence labeling, and extractive machine reading comprehension.
Users can create complex architectures by combining standard and reusable blocks from the Block Zoo.
